source: STEER Project (Save the Children, iDE Cambodia, and the Cambodian Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries) - "Guide on Banana Cultivation Techniques" (សៀវភៅណែនាំស្តីអំពី បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះដំណាំចេក), February 2020
text:
Banana needs consistent soil moisture, particularly during dry-season growth and while the bunch is filling out, but is intolerant of waterlogging. The guide recommends drip irrigation over flood or furrow watering: drip systems deliver water directly to the root zone and, according to the source, can reduce water use by roughly 30 to 65 percent compared with conventional irrigation, while also keeping foliage drier and reducing conditions that favor leaf disease.

Fields also need a drainage system to move excess water away after heavy rain, since waterlogged roots are prone to rot; farmers are advised to lay out drainage channels between rows as part of initial field preparation.
